description: Test suite for the ViteTemplate class, including setup for mock templates and configuration files, and tests for template initialization, project setup, post-processing execution, configuration loading, and variable replacement.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for project parameters, including name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and additional parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration representing project types, e.g., VITE.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data class representing initial template information such as commands and environment setup.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing projects based on templates and configurations.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides template data from a specified source directory.

classes.name: ViteTemplate
classes.description: Template class for Vite projects, providing methods to get initialization info and perform project setup.

methods.name: test_vite_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests that the ViteTemplate correctly provides initial configuration data.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the entire project initialization process, including directory structure and content replacement.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Verifies that post-processing scripts are executed successfully and affect the output.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks loading of project configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures that template variables within files are correctly replaced with project-specific values.
